# BONIRA — Project Cost Producer Contract Specification

Governed by `PD-010`.

`NO APPROVED PRODUCER CONTRACT → NO PROJECT COST FACT`

Common idempotency key:
`ProducerContractID + SourceType + SourceID + SourceVersion + RecognitionType`

## PCP-PO-COMMITMENT
- Source: approved/issued Purchase Order version.
- Trigger: eligible approved/issued version becomes effective.
- Project/CBS/cost classification: explicit validated mapping only.
- Amount/currency/effective date: from source-approved version; no invented valuation.
- Revision: adjusts/supersedes open commitment.
- Cancellation: releases remaining commitment.
- Target: `ProjectCostFact: COMMITMENT`.
- Level: `L2`.
- Integration: `INT-B11`.

## PCP-SUBCONTRACT-COMMITMENT
Same invariants:
- Source: approved Subcontract version.
- Amendment adjusts/supersedes.
- Cancellation/termination releases remaining commitment.
- Target: `ProjectCostFact: COMMITMENT`.
- Level: `L2`.
- Integration: `INT-B11`.

## Accrual / Relief
`PCP-GR-ACCRUAL` and `PCP-SERVICE-ACCRUAL` may create Accrual/relieve Commitment only where explicit source-specific valuation/mapping exists.

`NO APPROVED ACCRUAL MAPPING → NO ACCRUAL FACT / NO COMMITMENT RELIEF`

## Actual Producer Contracts
- `PCP-FIN-ACTUAL` — Treasury/Accounting eligible occurrence only where explicit mapping exists.
- `PCP-INV-ACTUAL` — eligible Inventory financial-effect event.
- `PCP-EQP-ACTUAL` — eligible Equipment cost evidence.
- `PCP-FA-ACTUAL` — eligible Fixed Asset/Depreciation cost evidence.
- `PCP-PAYR-ACTUAL` — finalized Payroll labor-cost evidence.

All are L2 unless explicit policy says otherwise. Source correction/reversal creates new reversing/superseding fact; historical facts are not deleted.

`IMPLEMENTATION AUTHORIZATION: NOT YET GRANTED`
